evaluation.checkpoint_selection: fixed final Joint8; no heldout selection

training.action_loss: mean squared error first10 x6 motor dimensions versus same-input same-seed BF16 teacher
training.latent_loss: global clean-future NMSE excluding clamped frame0; student-generated future remains connected to action
training.initialization: exact original H+VQ0 banks and U=I; H+VQ8 comparator uses same banks, update order, VQ lr, loss and 8 updates
training.joint_forward: A4((X/S) H U) @ Decode(C,g,I,e).T; compressed student coadaptation; no post-training refit
training.frozen: Smooth, original model parameters, VQ indices and B32 exponents; D=I and r=1
training.trainable: two stream-shared Cayley residuals, 614 codebook pairs and row gains
training.gradient_clip: VQ and R parameter groups independently norm-clipped at 1; VQ-only Adam state reset after update1
training.monitoring: per-update same-input pre/post metrics, initial/final complete C8; no heldout selection
training.control: H_currentpath: JointBanks with U=I frozen, VQ-only 8 updates; identical VQ gradient path to Joint8

rotation.sharing: one Cayley residual per eligible video/action/proprio stream; original signs retained per layer and block
rotation.parameterization: R=H128 U; U=solve(I-.5(A-A.T),I+.5(A-A.T)); A initially zero
rotation.execution: original signed FWHT followed by U, both stages in FP32, to preserve baseline arithmetic at U=I; no folded-kernel claim
rotation.tails: keep original fixed signed power-of-two transforms below 128
rotation.weight_precision_during_rotation: existing frozen R8 for diagnostics; joint learner uses actual decoded BF16 VQ weights

quantization.smooth: reuse exact frozen Smooth0.5 scales and signs from source banks
quantization.activations: dynamic per-token signed symmetric A4 qmax7, BF16 decoded operands
quantization.weights: d4 two additive 256-entry BF16 codebooks; BF16 row gains; B32 uint8 power-of-two exponents

fitting.moments: new R8 BF16W+A4 moments; normalize each context by token rows then equal contexts/suites

parameters.scope: paired fixed-input decoded-BF16/A4; calibration-only single R-LR refinement, frozen-U matched VQ8 implementation control, complete reused original diagnostic/reference arms; no native/closed-loop/significance claim
parameters.refinement: inspect complete diagnostics and Joint8 before deciding any further LR or gradient-accumulation arm; no automatic large sweep
